Premium v3 P1v3 (2 vCore, 8 GiB), 2 instances with autoscale rules (scale out to 3-4 in business hours), containerized Web API","rationale":"A managed PaaS plan runs the Web API container without a cluster fee or separate node VMs, and autoscale handles the spiky daytime load.","tradeoffs":["Single container per app, no Kubernetes primitives","Autoscale is slower to react than Container Apps' scale-to-demand","Instance sizes are fixed, so less fine-grained scaling"],"also_replaces":["c2"]},{"component_id":"c2","service":"Virtual Machines","sku":"Standard_D4as_v5","details":"Linux, AKS node pool with autoscaler: min 2 nodes, max 3, AMD-based D4as_v5 (4 vCPU, 16 GiB), scale down overnight","rationale":"AMD 'as' sizes are roughly 10% cheaper than D4s_v5 for the same vCPU/RAM, and a node pool autoscaler cuts to 2 nodes outside business hours.","tradeoffs":["AMD CPU, so verify image/architecture compatibility (x64, usually transparent)","Autoscaler adds some scale-up latency at the start of the day","2-node minimum reduces headroom/HA slightly at night"],"also_replaces":[]},{"component_id":"c3","service":"SQL Database","sku":"4 vCore","details":"General Purpose serverless, max 4 compute when idle at night, which suits a business-hours workload.","tradeoffs":["Cold-start delay of up to a minute after auto-pause (can disable pause and keep only min vCore)","Per-vCore rate is higher while active, so savings depend on real idle time","Memory is reclaimed when idle, so caches warm slowly in the morning"],"also_replaces":[]},{"component_id":"c3","service":"Azure Database for licensing cost, so equivalent 4 vCore compute is significantly cheaper if the app can run on PostgreSQL.","tradeoffs":["Requires app/schema migration from T-SQL to PostgreSQL","Not an option if the
